# 024-hotel

**Provider.** IHG (Holiday Inn Express), direct booking confirmation in British English.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. Brand header with the IHG One Rewards member name, a confirmation number bar, side-by-side check-in and check-out boxes, a nightly rate table and an app promotion block.

**Why.** Twelve-hour times ("After 3:00 PM", "Before 12:00 PM") to be turned into 15:00 and 12:00, a loyalty member number next to the confirmation number that must not be taken as the reference, nightly rates that differ, and a total that adds the 5% Edinburgh Visitor Levy to the VAT-inclusive room charge. Two adults stay but only the lead guest is named. The cancellation deadline is the day before arrival, which must not be read as a stay date.
